items.description: One row of the references section — a world NAMING another world, the primitive a wall-mounted portal placement (or any future consumer) resolves against. Authored data only: a row asserts nothing about the named world's existence or shape at boot — resolution is a consumer's job, not this section's (no boot-time existence check). Names its target through exactly one of two mutually exclusive spellings — a local document path (Document), or a remote owner-named world (Owner+World together, since worlds ARE users) — never both, never neither; ValidateReferences refuses any other shape. NeighbourKey folds whichever spelling was authored into the one opaque string every IWorldNeighbourResolver call site already passes around.

name.description: The reference's own name — SafeName-shaped, unique within the section.

document.description: The referenced world's document path (e.g. "dive.world.json"), authored verbatim. Mutually exclusive with Owner/World.

owner.description: The remote world's owning platform user id (an Entra oid) — worlds ARE users, so naming the owner names the world's account. Required together with World; refused alone.

world.description: The remote world's own SafeName-shaped id within its owner's account. Required together with Owner; refused alone.
